meta.name: specialized
meta.description: Specialized hardware interfaces and system reliability for Zephyr RTOS. Covers LVGL GUI development, Audio I2S/Codecs, Watchdog timers, and Fault Injection. Trigger when building human-machine interfaces (HMI), audio devices, or high-reliability mission-critical systems.

copy.tagline: 为 Zephyr RTOS 构建硬件接口和可靠系统
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果使用 Zephyr RTOS 开发需要硬件接口和高可靠性系统的嵌入式工程师。
copy.tagline_en: Build hardware interfaces and reliable systems for Zephyr RTOS.
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you are an embedded engineer using Zephyr RTOS for hardware interfaces and high-reliability systems.

howto.what: 安装后，Claude 能指导你为 Zephyr RTOS 开发图形界面、音频流、看门狗和故障注入等专用硬件功能。
howto.when: 当你要构建人机界面（HMI）、音频设备或高可靠性任务关键系统时，Claude 会接管相关指导。

say.text: 我想在 Zephyr 上用 LVGL 做一个仪表盘界面。
say.note: Claude 会提供 GUI 开发指导。

say.text: 帮我配置 I2S 音频驱动并消除启动时的爆音。
say.note: Claude 会给出零爆音音频设置方法。

say.text: 如何在 Zephyr 中实现看门狗定时器并喂狗？
say.note: Claude 会提供看门狗代码示例。

howto.what_en: This skill enables Claude to guide building specialized hardware interfaces and reliable systems for Zephyr RTOS, including LVGL GUI, audio I2S/codecs, watchdog timers, and fault injection.
howto.when_en: Triggered when building human-machine interfaces (HMI), audio devices, or mission-critical high-reliability systems.

say_en.text: I want to build a dashboard UI with LVGL on Zephyr.
Help me configure I2S audio driver and eliminate pop noise on start.
How to implement watchdog timer and feed it in Zephyr?
